column2: （可拉後裔的訓誨詩，又是愛慕歌，交與伶長。調用百合花。）我心裡湧出美辭；我論到我為王做的事，我的舌頭是快手筆。
column3: For the choir director; according to the Shoshannim. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A Song of Love. My heart overflows with a good theme; I address my verses to the King; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

column2: 你比世人更美；在你嘴裡滿有恩惠；所以神賜福給你，直到永遠。
column3: You are fairer than the sons of men; Grace is poured upon Your lips; Therefore God has blessed You forever.

column2: 大能者啊，願你腰間佩刀，大有榮耀和威嚴！
column3: Gird Your sword on [Your] thigh, O Mighty One, [In] Your splendor and Your majesty!

column2: 為真理、謙卑、公義赫然坐車前往，無不得勝；你的右手必顯明可畏的事。
column3: And in Your majesty ride on victoriously, For the cause of truth and meekness [and] righteousness; Let Your right hand teach You awesome things.

column2: 你的箭鋒快，射中王敵之心；萬民仆倒在你以下。
column3: Your arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under You; [Your arrows are] in the heart of the King's enemies.

column2: 神啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的；你的國權是正直的。
column3: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; A scepter of uprightness is the scepter of Your kingdom.

column2: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡；所以神─就是你的　神─用喜樂油膏你，勝過膏你的同伴。
column3: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of joy above Your fellows.

column2: 你的衣服都有沒藥、沉香、肉桂的香氣；象牙宮中有絲弦樂器的聲音使你歡喜。
column3: All Your garments are [fragrant with] myrrh and aloes [and] cassia; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made You glad.

column2: 有君王的女兒在你尊貴婦女之中；王后佩戴俄斐金飾站在你右邊。
column3: Kings' daughters are among Your noble ladies; At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.

column2: 女子啊，你要聽，要想，要側耳而聽！不要記念你的民和你的父家，
column3: Listen, O daughter, give attention and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father's house;

column2: 王就羨慕你的美貌；因為他是你的主，你當敬拜他。
column3: Then the King will desire your beauty. Because He is your Lord, bow down to Him.

column2: 推羅的民（原文是女子）必來送禮；民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
column3: The daughter of Tyre [will come] with a gift; The rich among the people will seek your favor.

column2: 王女在宮裡極其榮華；他的衣服是用金線繡的。
column3: The King's daughter is all glorious within; Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

column2: 他要穿錦繡的衣服，被引到王前；隨從他的陪伴童女也要被帶到你面前。
column3: She will be led to the King in embroidered work; The virgins, her companions who follow her, Will be brought to You.

column2: 他們要歡喜快樂被引導；他們要進入王宮。
column3: They will be led forth with gladness and rejoicing; They will enter into the King's palace.

column2: 你的子孫要接續你的列祖；你要立他們在全地作王。
column3: In place of your fathers will be your sons; You shall make them princes in all the earth.

column2: 我必叫你的名被萬代記念，所以萬民要永永遠遠稱謝你。
column3: I will cause Your name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore the peoples will give You thanks forever and ever.
